llm_details.reasoning: No bounds check on payload_offset or the payload length is visible prior to the memcpy of sizeof(struct ndpi_dns_packet_header) bytes from flow->packet.payload[x].

The access is guarded by `if((x + data_len) <= flow->packet.payload_packet_len)` which ensures the read from `flow->packet.payload + x` of length `data_len` remains within the bounds of `payload_packet_len`, and `data_len` is further restricted to 4 or 16.

In `search_valid_dns`, `memcpy` copies `sizeof(struct ndpi_dns_packet_header)` (12 bytes) from `&flow->packet.payload[x]` without first verifying that `flow->packet.payload_packet_len >= payload_offset + sizeof(struct ndpi_dns_packet_header)`. If a packet has fewer than 12 bytes of payload (or less remaining after `payload_offset`), this results in an out-of-bounds read from `flow->packet.payload`.
